rows.name: Hall Effect/Rapid Trigger
rows.note: Wooting's support channels began posting tracking-number confirmations this week for early 80HE+ ABS/Module orders, ending the three-week stretch of ship-date uncertainty.

rows.name: Cherry MX2A
rows.note: Same story for a third week: Cherry has not announced new MX2A colorways or addressed last year's scratchiness complaints, and sentiment continues its slow bleed rather than reversing.

rows.name: TMR (Tunnel Magnetoresistance) switches
rows.note: Keychron posted a backer update confirming the V6 Ultra Hybrid TMR line entered final QC ahead of its November ship window, though no units have shipped yet.

rows.name: Gateron Magnetic Jade Delta
rows.note: No restock, teardown, or new vendor listing appeared this week; Jade Delta continues to sit in the same fulfillment-queue holding pattern it has held for a month.

rows.name: Gateron Oil King
rows.note: Still no vendor campaign or SKU refresh; Oil King's steady-state availability continues unchanged into a second week.

rows.name: Durock T1
rows.note: T1 continues its slow fade from conversation with no catalyst in sight; vendor listings are unchanged from two weeks ago.

rows.name: GMK CYL Red Devils R2
rows.note: No restock, teardown, or shipping update has emerged in five weeks since close; the set appears to be in a quiet production phase vendors haven't detailed.

rows.name: GMK CYL Zombie
rows.note: Zombie's group buy opened this week on the original vendor's storefront, roughly five weeks behind its initially teased Oct 2-31 window, reviving interest-check traffic.

rows.name: DCS Dolch / Molch
rows.note: No further revision to Dolch's November ship estimate appeared this week, and Molch's Q1 2027 window remains unchanged on Divinikey's listing.

rows.name: Split/Ergo layout
rows.note: MoErgo synced its Go60 Golden Kiwi SKU pages to a single fulfillment estimate this week, though the figure itself did not move from the latest date previously shown.

rows.name: Alice layout
rows.note: No new Alice-layout board or restock surfaced this week; Tide Alice and QK Alice Duo remain the only active listings driving the category's slow, flat climb.

rows.name: 75% Layout
rows.note: 75% boards hold steady as the default form factor with no new credible restock or group-buy news this week across major vendor storefronts.

rows.name: CannonKeys
rows.note: CannonKeys updated its add-ons page this week to show Q1 2027 for Blaine V2: SE, matching the reseller estimate that had circulated for two weeks and effectively confirming the slip.

rows.name: Mode Designs
rows.note: No Mode Designs announcement broke the lull again this week; both Sonnet and Encore listings are unchanged from the prior snapshot.

rows.name: Prototypist
rows.note: With GMK CYL MONO's Nov 30 close three weeks out, Prototypist's proxy-order volume for the set keeps climbing week over week.

rows.name: Keychron
rows.note: Keychron's backer update confirming V6 Ultra Hybrid TMR's final QC step offset continued scattered Q16 HE 8K stockouts, leaving brand sentiment roughly where it started the month.

rows.name: Wooting
rows.note: Wooting confirmed the first wave of 80HE+ ABS/Module units shipped this week, with order-status pages updating to tracking-number status for early backers after the extended delay.

rows.name: ZMK firmware
rows.note: ZMK still has no dated release on its roadmap; this week's only adjacent chatter was MoErgo syncing Go60 Golden Kiwi fulfillment estimates across SKUs.
